evals.prompt: the video block PR (emdash-cms/emdash#3827) just merged, can you make me a quick X post about it from my personal account? i'm a core maintainer and i built it. one image please
evals.expected_output: Asks only what's missing (free or Premium account, dark or light card), verifies the feature from the PR, writes one first-person post that discloses the author built it, renders one landscape card from a real screenshot, lints the post, and delivers a social-<slug>/ folder with the card and a thread file.

evals.prompt: Turn the EmDash 1.1 release into a Bluesky thread for the official account, plus a LinkedIn post for me (core maintainer). Reuse the 1.1 cards if they fit.
evals.expected_output: Writes a brand-voice Bluesky thread under 300 characters per post and a single first-person LinkedIn post with the hook in the first ~210 characters, no emojis or colon constructions, link last, separate thread files per account, both linted with the matching --platform.

evals.prompt: Daniel built the Microsoft Entra sign-in for 1.1. Write a short post he can share from his own account, and a shout-out from @emdashcms that credits him.
evals.expected_output: Asks for Daniel's handle on the target platform instead of guessing it, writes a contributor-voice post (EmDash 1.1 shipped, thanks to the maintainers) and a brand shout-out, with different wording, reusing the Microsoft sign-in card.
